rules.title: California Civil Code Section 1950.5 (Security deposits)
rules.requirement: On a landlord's transfer of interest, the remaining deposit must be transferred to the successor or returned to the tenant with an accounting, and the tenant must be notified. Successors are jointly liable for noncompliance, a lease may not call a deposit "nonrefundable," and bad faith retention can lead to statutory damages.
rules.key_value: Statutory damages up to twice the amount of the security for bad faith
rules.penalty: Statutory damages of up to twice the amount of the security, in addition to actual damages, for bad faith claim or retention
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2025, Ch. 340, Sec. 1 (AB 414), effective January 1, 2026
rules.quoted_span: (n) A lease or rental agreement shall not contain a provision characterizing any security as “nonrefundable.”
